rules.title: Valid Passport (6-Month Minimum Validity)
rules.summary: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months past your entry date.
rules.simpleExplanation: Immigration officers inspect your passport to check it has at least 6 months left before it expires and at least 2 full blank visa pages.
rules.applicableCondition: Mandatory for all international travelers entering Uganda.
rules.officialSource: Uganda Directorate of Citizenship & Immigration Control (DCIC)

checklist.title: Biometric / Regular Passport
checklist.description: Minimum 6-month validity with at least 2 consecutive blank stamp pages.
checklist.guidanceNote: Carry the physical document. Digital scans on phones are not accepted for entry.

rules.title: Ugandan Citizen Entry (National ID or Passport)
rules.summary: No visa required. Present Ugandan passport or National ID card.
rules.simpleExplanation: As a returning citizen of the Republic of Uganda you have the right of entry. Present your valid Ugandan passport or National ID card.

rules.title: East African Community (EAC) Free Movement
rules.summary: Visa-free entry under EAC Common Market Protocol.
rules.simpleExplanation: Citizens of {nationality} can enter Uganda without a visa under EAC arrangements. Present a valid passport or a recognised EAC identity document.

rules.title: Bilateral Visa Exemption (Up to 90 Days)
rules.summary: Nationals of {nationality} are exempt from tourist/business visas.
rules.simpleExplanation: Under reciprocal agreements, visitors from {nationality} can enter without a visa for short visits. An entry endorsement stamp is issued at immigration.

rules.title: Mandatory Uganda Electronic Visa (e-Visa)
rules.summary: Must be applied for and approved online before departure.
rules.simpleExplanation: Uganda no longer issues visas on arrival. Apply online at visas.immigration.go.ug and carry the printed approval letter.
rules.applicableCondition: Mandatory for citizens of {nationality} traveling for {purpose}.
rules.officialSource: Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control (DCIC)

checklist.title: Uganda Electronic Visa (Approval Letter)
checklist.description: Printed official e-Visa approval letter from visas.immigration.go.ug
checklist.guidanceNote: Do not use third-party visa sites. Only visas.immigration.go.ug is official.

rules.title: East Africa Tourist Visa (Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya)
rules.summary: Joint multi-entry visa across 3 East African partner states.
rules.simpleExplanation: Because you plan to travel across Uganda and neighbouring countries, apply for the East Africa Tourist Visa through the immigration authority of the first country you enter.

checklist.title: East Africa Tourist Visa
checklist.description: Approved joint visa for Uganda, Kenya and Rwanda
checklist.guidanceNote: Apply through the first country you enter.

rules.title: Transit Visa for Passing Through Uganda
rules.summary: A short transit visa applies when you pass through Uganda to another country.
rules.simpleExplanation: If you only pass through Uganda on a direct overland route you need a transit visa, and proof that you can enter your next country.

checklist.title: Uganda Transit Visa
checklist.description: Transit visa for a direct overland route
checklist.guidanceNote: Confirm the current fee and allowed days on the official portal.

rules.title: Yellow Fever Vaccination Certificate (Strictly Mandatory)
rules.summary: Mandatory for all arrivals aged 1 year and above.
rules.simpleExplanation: Port Health officers inspect the yellow card before you reach immigration. The vaccine must have been given at least 10 days before arrival.
rules.applicableCondition: Strict requirement for all travelers entering Uganda.
rules.officialSource: Ministry of Health Uganda & WHO Guidelines

checklist.title: Yellow Fever Vaccination Yellow Card
checklist.description: Official WHO International Certificate of Vaccination or Prophylaxis.
checklist.guidanceNote: Must be given at least 10 days before arrival. Checked by Port Health before immigration.

rules.title: Confirmed Return or Onward Ticket
rules.summary: Proof of departure within the authorised stay.
rules.simpleExplanation: Border officers may ask for proof that you will leave Uganda within your permitted stay.

checklist.title: Confirmed Return / Onward Itinerary
checklist.description: Proof of travel leaving Uganda within your authorised stay.
checklist.guidanceNote: A phone e-ticket or a printout is accepted.

rules.title: Accommodation Booking or Local Host Details
rules.summary: Hotel confirmation, lodge reservation, or host address.
rules.simpleExplanation: You will be asked for the address and phone number of where you will stay in Uganda.

checklist.title: Proof of Accommodation / Booking
checklist.description: Hotel voucher, booking confirmation, or signed host invitation with a phone number.
checklist.guidanceNote: Needed to complete the entry card.

rules.title: Uganda Wildlife Authority (UWA) Tracking Permit
rules.summary: Required for gorilla trekking in Bwindi / chimpanzees in Kibale.
rules.simpleExplanation: Permits are booked in advance through UWA or a licensed tour operator. Rangers check the voucher at the park gate.
rules.applicableCondition: Visiting Bwindi, Mgahinga or Kibale National Parks.

checklist.title: UWA Gorilla / Chimpanzee Trekking Permit
checklist.description: Official Uganda Wildlife Authority tracking voucher.
checklist.guidanceNote: Show it at the park briefing centre.

rules.title: Travel Medical & Emergency Evacuation Cover
rules.summary: Strongly recommended, especially for safaris.
rules.simpleExplanation: Not checked at immigration, but cover that includes medical evacuation is strongly advised for remote areas.

checklist.title: Travel & Medical Insurance
checklist.guidanceNote: Recommended for safaris and remote parks.

rules.title: Joint Immigration Clearance at Malaba One-Stop Border Post (OSBP)
rules.summary: Kenya-Uganda joint clearance in one terminal.
rules.simpleExplanation: Under the EAC OSBP arrangement you stop once on the Ugandan side. Paired immigration and health officers process your exit and entry together.

rules.title: Cross-Border Vehicle Clearance & COMESA Insurance
rules.summary: Required for cars, tour vehicles and trucks crossing by road.
rules.simpleExplanation: Drivers carry the original logbook and COMESA Yellow Card insurance and obtain a URA Temporary Movement Permit (Form C32).

rules.title: Exit Inspection & Souvenir Customs Clearance
rules.summary: Security screening and wildlife-product clearance on departure.
rules.simpleExplanation: Allow time for clearance when leaving. Exporting protected wildlife products, untreated seeds or minerals without permits is prohibited.

rules.title: Business Visit: Invitation or Host Company Letter
rules.summary: Often requested for business visits.
rules.simpleExplanation: Carry a letter from the company or organisation you are visiting, with contact details, in case officers ask about the purpose of your trip.
rules.officialSource: Seeded from prototype guidance; to be verified with DCIC

checklist.title: Business Invitation / Host Company Letter
checklist.description: Letter from the host company or organisation with contact details.

rules.title: Study: Admission Letter
rules.summary: Proof that you are joining a school or programme.
rules.simpleExplanation: Carry the admission or enrolment letter from your institution. Long stays may need a student pass; check with the institution and DCIC.
rules.officialSource: Seeded from prototype guidance; to be verified with DCIC

checklist.title: Admission / Enrolment Letter
checklist.description: Letter from your school, university or programme.
checklist.guidanceNote: Ask the institution about a student pass for long stays.

rules.title: Family Visit: Host Invitation and Contact Details
rules.summary: Details of the relative you are visiting.
rules.simpleExplanation: Carry your host's name, address and phone number, and an invitation letter if possible.
rules.officialSource: Seeded from prototype guidance; to be verified with DCIC

checklist.title: Host Invitation and Contact Details
checklist.description: Host name, address, phone number and an invitation letter if available.
checklist.guidanceNote: Keep the host reachable by phone on arrival day.

rules.title: Transit: Entry Permission for Your Next Country
rules.summary: You must be able to enter the country you are travelling to.
rules.simpleExplanation: When passing through Uganda, carry a valid visa, residence permit or proof of citizenship for your final destination.
rules.officialSource: Seeded from prototype guidance (DCIC Border Management); to be verified

checklist.title: Entry Permission for Next Country
checklist.description: Visa, residence permit or proof of citizenship for your final destination.
checklist.guidanceNote: Officers may ask to see it.

rules.title: Work or Assignment: Permit or Employer Letter
rules.summary: Proof of your work assignment in Uganda.
rules.simpleExplanation: Carry your work permit, or a letter from your employer or organisation describing your assignment and its length.
rules.applicableCondition: Travelling for work, an NGO assignment or a posting.
rules.officialSource: Seeded from prototype guidance; to be verified with DCIC

checklist.title: Work Permit / Employer Letter
checklist.description: Work permit, or a letter from your employer about your assignment.
checklist.guidanceNote: Ask your employer which permit applies to your role.
